caption: The drawing features two round, bronze-colored medals centered side by side on a plain, light beige background. The left medal displays a right-facing male profile in relief, with detailed facial features and hair, surrounded by engraved text along the edge. The right medal depicts a scene with three human figures; one standing woman extending her arm toward two seated figures, with additional objects and details near them, and the number "1847" engraved at the bottom. Both medals have shaded and highlighted areas, indicating their metallic sheen and three-dimensional form.
title: Medal (Bronze)
